purpose: Inspect charging-derived implied pack-capacity evidence, uncertainty, model assumptions, diagnostics, coverage and exact source-row accounting.
primaryGoal: Understand the returned charging-history window without mistaking implied capacity or evidence support for battery health, degradation, safety or remaining life.

issues.detail: Feature query state forwards only resolution/errors/retry, not source success timestamp or stale status. Ordinary retained readings without a refresh error carry no visible retrieval freshness; observed recency is a frozen analysis measurement, not query freshness.
issues.fix: Preserve DataState trust fields through the feature adapter and show source freshness using the existing brief/source-notice contract. Do not reinterpret observation recency as fetch age or discard retained evidence.

visualIssues.detail: Five support ingredients assign five distinct chartTokens hues, and coverage assigns cyan/green/blue/purple/amber/red to independent KPI icons. This is decorative multi-hue noise to review; no rendered saturation or contrast measurement is claimed. No neon/glow/pure-white class occurs in the page itself. MetricCard consumes toned c.text, not neonColorMap.glow.
visualIssues.fix: Use a restrained shared semantic/default color for ordinary coverage and support ingredients while keeping color/data identity for genuine analytical series and preserving explicit user chart preferences. Do not change global tokens in a page task.

architectureIssues.detail: Feature imports StatMetric from data-display/stat-reference and LayoutCard from layout/layout-reference; RowAccounting repeats the stat-reference import and Placement imports layout-reference for useCardPlacement. This bypasses canonical category API ownership.
architectureIssues.fix: Use existing category exports for already exported StatMetric/LayoutCard. Check useCardPlacement category availability with its owner; export the existing implementation only if missing, never add a competing placement hook.

architectureIssues.detail: Process-noise x axis displays unit ' Wh', whereas the control, methodology and export column describe Wh / square-root day. The raw numeric values remain canonical; axis annotation loses the process-rate meaning.
architectureIssues.fix: Preserve process-noise values and provide localized complete axis/unit context using the existing chart presentation, without converting it as an ordinary energy measurement.

sections.name: Capacity evidence summary and assumption controls

auxiliaryNotices: Summary query status and per-section passive gates
actions: Change minimum SoC window: 5/10/20/30/40 percentage points; default 10.
Change process noise: 10/30/60/120 Wh per square-root day; default 30.
Retry fatal/refresh failures and paused work via existing source retry.
Existing OperationalBrief review/details interaction with full metric context and provenance.
Existing chart toolbar, export and data alternatives; preserve supplied rows, labels, chartKey and supported hidden-series state.
Measurement directory value filters and canonical DataTable persistence/mobile/details/export behavior; accounting table category/count/share.
Consume shell-owned selected vehicle; do not add another page vehicle picker.
dataBehavior: Returned-history analysis is bounded, not lifetime or calibrated health evidence; retain 1000-row cap disclosures.
Mount-frozen nowMs and vehicle-local calendar affect future classification, cadence, recency and months; preserve defaults and selected assumption state.
Validation reads raw Wh and SoC endpoints, rejects invalid/future/incomplete rows, then accounts for duplicate/overlap/cap reasons without imputing unknowns.
Retain posterior, sigma, gain, innovation, all summary and support calculations; fit gates are 12 observations, 180 days and six active months.
Display caps: 24 trend months, 200 timeline points, 25 directory measurements; omitted rows are disclosed and summaries retain included analysis rows.
Directory fields: completion, SoC gain, energy added, raw capacity, filtered capacity, posterior sigma, gain, standardized innovation, location.
Accounting retains fourteen mutually exclusive primary categories and returned = included + excluded invariant.
Energy conversion is display-only via formatEnergy and convertEnergyFromSI; no hook/cache mutation or fake data.
Keep all ten methodology explanations, explicit limits and all localized captions, uncertainty qualifications and non-claims.
